title: Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation for ROC AUC and F1
description: Evaluate the logistic regression pipeline clf across 5 stratified folds on (X_clf, y_clf) using both roc_auc and f1 scoring.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Create `skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)` and compute 5-fold cross-validation scores for `clf` on `(X_clf, y_clf)` using `scoring='roc_auc'` (`auc_cv`) and `scoring='f1'` (`f1_cv`).
Print the mean and standard deviation across the 5 folds for both `auc_cv` and `f1_cv`.

Compare `StratifiedKFold` on line 1 with the two scorers on lines 4-5. `StratifiedKFold` keeps the malignant/benign ratio balanced in every fold. `'roc_auc'` scores continuous probabilities from `predict_proba`, and `'f1'` scores hard class-1 predictions.

steps.question: Why does line 1 use `StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5)` instead of plain `KFold(n_splits=5)` for `(X_clf, y_clf)`?
steps.answer: `StratifiedKFold` preserves the proportion of class 0 (`malignant`) and class 1 (`benign`) samples in each of the 5 folds.

steps.description: Line 4 runs 5-fold stratified cross-validation with `scoring='roc_auc'`, storing the 5 fold AUCs in `auc_cv`.
